segments.he: חַלּוֹת – בּוֹלְלָן, דִּבְרֵי רַבִּי, וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: סוֹלֶת.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: With regard to meal offerings that come as loaves, i.e., those prepared in a shallow pan or deep pan or those baked in an oven, it is after the flour has been baked into «loaves» that one breaks them into pieces and «mixes them» with oil; this is «the statement of Rabbi» Yehuda HaNasi. «And the Rabbis say:» It is with «fine flour,» before the baking, that one mixes the oil.
